title: How Do Things Fly? Rockets, Airplanes, Helicopters for Kids with Gizmo
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Gizmo the robot, and welcome to Gizmo Explains!
I love asking, how does that work? Today we're going to find out how things fly.
We'll explore five cool things. Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
When my antenna lights up, it means I have an idea!

lines: Here's a clue: it blasts off into space! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
A rocket burns fuel and pushes hot gas down, really hard.
Pushing down makes the rocket go up, up, up!
Can you count down with me? Three, two, one, blast off!
Which way does the rocket push?
Down! And that sends it up!
One more time, nice and loud: ROCKET!
Rockets carry astronauts and satellites to space.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it has big wings and flies above the clouds! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Airplane wings are curved on top.
When the plane zooms forward, the wings push air down and lift the plane up!
Can you stretch your arms out like wings and zoom?
Its wings, moving through the air!
One more time, nice and loud: AIRPLANE!
Engines push the plane forward fast.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it's a giant floating balloon with a basket! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
A burner heats the air inside the balloon.
Hot air is lighter than cool air, so it floats up!
Can you float up slowly, rising on your tiptoes?
Why does a hot air balloon go up?
Let's say it together: HOT AIR BALLOON!
One more time, nice and loud: HOT AIR BALLOON!
To come down, the pilot lets the air cool.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it has spinning blades on top! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
A helicopter's blades spin really fast.
The spinning blades push air down, so the helicopter goes straight up!
Can you spin your arms like helicopter blades?
Yes! And they can hover in one place!
One more time, nice and loud: HELICOPTER!
Helicopters can land in small spaces.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it flies on a string on a windy day! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
The string holds it, so the kite climbs up high!
Can you pretend to hold a kite string? Hold on tight!
What does a kite need to fly?
One more time, nice and loud: KITE!
Running helps the kite catch the wind.
Now we know how it works. Great job!

recap: Wow, we learned so much! Let's remember.
Rockets push down to go up.
Hot air balloons rise with hot air.
outro: Which one was your favorite? Keep asking, how does that work?
Bye, friends! See you next time on Gizmo Explains!
